import urllib.request
import json

# Check HGNC REST API
url = "https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/hgnc_id/HGNC:5870"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'Python/urllib'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        doc = data['response']['docs'][0]
        print("HGNC Symbol:", doc.get('symbol'))
        print("HGNC Name:", doc.get('name'))
        print("HGNC alias_symbol:", doc.get('alias_symbol'))
        print("HGNC prev_symbol:", doc.get('prev_symbol'))
except Exception as e:
    print("HGNC error:", e)

# Also check if ECA3 exists in HGNC
url2 = "https://rest.genenames.org/search/symbol/ECA3"
req2 = urllib.request.Request(url2, headers={'Accept': 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'Python/urllib'})
